enrol.en: You must enrol on the course by the end of September.
enrol.zh: 你必须在九月底前注册这门课程。

enrolment.en: Enrolment for evening classes begins next Monday in the main building.
enrolment.zh: 夜校注册下周一在主楼开始。

orientation.en: New students will get a campus map during orientation week.
orientation.zh: 新生会在迎新周拿到校园地图。

semester.en: The second semester begins in February, after a three-week break.
semester.zh: 三周假期过后,第二学期在二月开始。

term.en: The library stays open until midnight during the summer term.
term.zh: 夏季学期图书馆开放到午夜。

term.en: Your tutor will explain any technical terms you don't understand.
term.zh: 导师会解释你不懂的专业术语。

course.en: I'm taking a one-year course in business management.
course.zh: 我正在修一门为期一年的商业管理课程。

module.en: Each module lasts ten weeks and ends with a short written test.
module.zh: 每个课程模块持续十周,最后有一次简短的笔试。

compulsory.en: Statistics is compulsory for all first-year psychology students.
compulsory.zh: 统计学是心理学专业大一学生的必修课。

optional.en: The field trip is optional, but most students choose to go.
optional.zh: 实地考察是选修的,但大多数学生都会去。

elective.en: I chose marine biology as my elective this semester.
elective.zh: 这学期我选了海洋生物学作为选修课。

prerequisite.en: Basic statistics is a prerequisite for this research methods course.
prerequisite.zh: 基础统计学是这门研究方法课的先修课程。

credit.en: You need sixty credits to complete the first year of the degree.
credit.zh: 你需要修满六十个学分才能完成学位的第一年。

credit.en: Buying a car on credit can cost you more in the long run.
credit.zh: 从长远看,用信用贷款买车可能花费更多。

syllabus.en: You can download the syllabus and reading list from the course website.
syllabus.zh: 你可以从课程网站下载教学大纲和阅读书目。

curriculum.en: The school has added computer programming to its curriculum this year.
curriculum.zh: 学校今年把计算机编程加入了课程体系。

lecture.en: Today's lecture will look at the causes of the French Revolution.
lecture.zh: 今天的讲座将探讨法国大革命的起因。

lecturer.en: Our lecturer has put all the slides on the university website.
lecturer.zh: 我们的讲师把所有幻灯片都放到了大学网站上。

tutorial.en: We'll discuss your essay plan in next week's tutorial.
tutorial.zh: 我们会在下周的辅导课上讨论你的论文提纲。

tutor.en: My tutor suggested that I read more before starting the essay.
tutor.zh: 我的导师建议我在动笔前多读些资料。

seminar.en: Everyone must read the article before Thursday's seminar on climate policy.
seminar.zh: 大家必须在周四的气候政策研讨会前读完这篇文章。

workshop.en: There's a free workshop on academic writing in the library this Friday.
workshop.zh: 本周五图书馆有一场免费的学术写作工作坊。

professor.en: Professor Lee will give the opening talk at the conference.
professor.zh: 李教授将在会议上作开场发言。

faculty.en: The Faculty of Science is in the new building beside the lake.
faculty.zh: 理学院位于湖边的新大楼。

campus.en: Most of the shops and cafés are in the centre of campus.
campus.zh: 大多数商店和咖啡馆都在校园中心。

undergraduate.en: Undergraduates can borrow up to ten books from the library at a time.
undergraduate.zh: 本科生一次最多可以从图书馆借十本书。

postgraduate.en: Postgraduate students have their own study room on the fourth floor.
postgraduate.zh: 研究生在五楼有自己的自习室。

fresher.en: As a fresher, I found it difficult to find my way around campus.
fresher.zh: 作为新生,我发现在校园里很难找到路。

alumni.en: Many of the college's alumni come back to give talks to students.
alumni.zh: 学院的许多校友回校给学生做讲座。

mature-student.en: As a mature student, I find it hard to balance work and family.
mature-student.zh: 作为大龄学生,我觉得很难平衡工作和家庭。

international-student.en: The support office helps each international student to settle in during the first month.
international-student.zh: 支持办公室在第一个月帮助每位留学生适应环境。

bachelors-degree.en: You need a bachelor's degree to apply for this teaching course.
bachelors-degree.zh: 申请这门教师课程需要有学士学位。

masters-degree.en: She's doing a master's degree in engineering at a university in Glasgow.
masters-degree.zh: 她正在格拉斯哥一所大学攻读工程硕士学位。

doctorate.en: He spent five years working on his doctorate in chemistry.
doctorate.zh: 他花了五年时间攻读化学博士学位。

phd.en: She's doing a PhD on the history of medicine in Asia.
phd.zh: 她正在攻读亚洲医学史方向的博士学位。

major.en: My major is economics, but I'm also taking a course in history.
major.zh: 我主修经济学,但也在修一门历史课。

major.en: I decided to major in biology after a great teacher inspired me.
major.zh: 一位很棒的老师激励了我,于是我决定主修生物学。

discipline.en: Psychology is a discipline that draws on both science and social studies.
discipline.zh: 心理学是一门兼具科学和社会研究的学科。

discipline.en: Good teachers can maintain discipline in class without raising their voices.
discipline.zh: 好老师不用提高嗓门就能维持课堂纪律。

assignment.en: The history assignment has to be at least two thousand words long.
assignment.zh: 这份历史作业至少要写两千词。

coursework.en: Coursework counts for forty percent of your final mark.
coursework.zh: 课程作业占你最终成绩的百分之四十。

essay.en: I have to write an essay on population growth by next Tuesday.
essay.zh: 我必须在下周二前写一篇关于人口增长的论文。

dissertation.en: I'm writing my dissertation on how tourism affects small islands.
dissertation.zh: 我正在写学位论文,研究旅游业如何影响小岛。

thesis.en: He finished his thesis on Roman trade and handed it in last week.
thesis.zh: 他写完了关于罗马贸易的论文,上周交了上去。

thesis.en: The main thesis of the book is that cities shape how we think.
thesis.zh: 这本书的主要论点是城市塑造了我们的思维方式。

draft.en: Please send me a first draft of your report by Wednesday.
draft.zh: 请在周三前把报告初稿发给我。

draft.en: I need to draft an email to the tutor about my late essay.
draft.zh: 我得起草一封邮件给导师,说明论文迟交的事。

deadline.en: The deadline for the essay is five o'clock on Friday afternoon.
deadline.zh: 论文的截止时间是周五下午五点。

extension.en: I asked my tutor for an extension because I'd been ill.
extension.zh: 我生病了,所以向导师申请延期。

submit.en: You must submit your assignment online before midnight on Sunday.
submit.zh: 你必须在周日午夜前在线提交作业。

presentation.en: Each group will give a ten-minute presentation at the end of the course.
presentation.zh: 每个小组将在课程结束时做十分钟的展示。

handout.en: I'll give you a handout with all the main points after the lecture.
handout.zh: 讲座结束后,我会发一份包含所有要点的讲义。

feedback.en: Your tutor will give you feedback on your essay within two weeks.
feedback.zh: 导师会在两周内就你的论文给出反馈。

grade.en: I got a good grade in maths but failed my science test.
grade.zh: 我数学成绩不错,但科学考试没及格。

grade.en: The teachers will grade all the papers by the end of next week.
grade.zh: 老师们将在下周末前批改完所有试卷。

mark.en: You need a mark of at least sixty percent to pass the module.
mark.zh: 这门课程模块至少要得百分之六十的分数才算通过。

mark.en: It takes the lecturers about two weeks to mark all the exam papers.
mark.zh: 讲师们大约需要两周才能批改完所有试卷。

assessment.en: The assessment for this course includes a test and a group project.
assessment.zh: 这门课的评估包括一次测验和一个小组项目。

examination.en: The final examination will take place in the sports hall in June.
examination.zh: 期末考试将于六月在体育馆举行。

revision.en: I've started my revision, but there's still a lot to cover.
revision.zh: 我已经开始复习了,但还有很多内容要看。

revision.en: The report needs some revision before we send it to the client.
revision.zh: 这份报告在发给客户之前还需要修改。

plagiarism.en: Plagiarism is taken very seriously, and you could be asked to leave the course.
plagiarism.zh: 抄袭的处理非常严肃,你可能会被要求退出课程。

attendance.en: Attendance at all the seminars is compulsory for first-year students.
attendance.zh: 大一学生必须出席所有研讨课。

registration.en: Registration for the conference opens at eight in the main hall.
registration.zh: 会议登记八点在主厅开始。

student-union.en: The student union organises parties and cheap trips throughout the year.
student-union.zh: 学生会全年组织派对和便宜的旅行。

society.en: I've joined the film society, and we meet on Tuesday nights.
society.zh: 我加入了电影社团,我们每周二晚上聚会。

society.en: Technology has changed the way people in modern society communicate.
society.zh: 科技改变了现代社会人们的交流方式。

counsellor.en: The college counsellor helped me deal with the stress before my exams.
counsellor.zh: 学院的心理咨询师帮我缓解了考前压力。

accommodation-office.en: Ask at the accommodation office if you need help finding a room.
accommodation-office.zh: 如果需要帮忙找房间,可以到住宿办公室咨询。

careers-service.en: The careers service can check your CV and help you prepare for interviews.
careers-service.zh: 就业指导中心可以帮你检查简历并准备面试。

prospectus.en: You can order a free prospectus from the college's website.
prospectus.zh: 你可以在学院网站上免费索取招生简章。

freshman.en: As a freshman, I lived in a dorm right in the middle of campus.
freshman.zh: 大一时,我住在校园正中央的宿舍里。

sophomore.en: She's a sophomore at a college in Boston, studying computer science.
sophomore.zh: 她是波士顿一所大学的大二学生,学习计算机科学。

junior.en: He's a junior now and has to choose a topic for his final project.
junior.zh: 他现在大三了,必须为毕业设计选题。

junior.en: I started as a junior engineer and worked my way up over ten years.
junior.zh: 我从初级工程师做起,用十年时间一步步晋升。

senior.en: As a senior, she spends most of her time on her final project.
senior.zh: 作为大四学生,她大部分时间都花在毕业设计上。

senior.en: A senior nurse showed me what to do on my first day.
senior.zh: 第一天,一位资深护士教我该做什么。

headmaster.en: The headmaster gave a short speech at the start of the school year.
headmaster.zh: 校长在学年开始时作了简短讲话。

principal.en: The principal of the college will welcome new students on Monday.
principal.zh: 学院院长周一将欢迎新生。

principal.en: The principal reason for the delay was a shortage of staff.
principal.zh: 延误的主要原因是人手不足。

scholar.en: The library contains rare books used by scholars from all over the world.
scholar.zh: 图书馆收藏着世界各地学者使用的珍本书。

cram.en: I had to cram for three days because I'd missed so many classes.
cram.zh: 我缺了很多课,只好突击学习了三天。

textbook.en: The textbook for this course is expensive, so try to buy a used copy.
textbook.zh: 这门课的教科书很贵,所以尽量买二手的。

humanities.en: Students in the humanities often have fewer class hours than those in science.
humanities.zh: 人文学科的学生课时通常比理科生少。

sociology.en: In sociology, we study how families and social groups change over time.
sociology.zh: 在社会学中,我们研究家庭和社会群体如何随时间变化。

zoology.en: My degree in zoology included a field trip to study wild birds.
zoology.zh: 我的动物学学位课程包括一次研究野生鸟类的实地考察。

biochemistry.en: Biochemistry is a difficult subject, but there are plenty of jobs for graduates.
biochemistry.zh: 生物化学很难学,但毕业生的工作机会很多。

commerce.en: She studied commerce at university and now runs her own small business.
commerce.zh: 她在大学学的是商业,现在经营自己的小公司。

score.en: You need a score of at least 6.5 to get onto this course.
score.zh: 你至少要考到 6.5 分才能上这门课。

score.en: Students who score above ninety in the test don't need extra classes.
score.zh: 测试得分在九十以上的学生不需要额外上课。

refresher-course.en: I'm taking a refresher course because I haven't used French for years.
refresher-course.zh: 我已经多年没用法语了,所以在上进修课程。

intensive-course.en: This intensive course covers a full year of Spanish in just eight weeks.
intensive-course.zh: 这门强化课程只用八周就学完一整年的西班牙语内容。

notice-board.en: The exam timetable will be put on the notice board outside the office.
notice-board.zh: 考试时间表会贴在办公室外的布告栏上。

word-limit.en: Your essay will lose marks if it goes over the word limit.
word-limit.zh: 论文超出字数限制会被扣分。

take-notes.en: It's a good idea to take notes during the lecture and read them later.
take-notes.zh: 听讲座时记笔记,之后再看一遍,是个好办法。

dropout-rate.en: The dropout rate is much higher among students who work full-time.
dropout-rate.zh: 全职工作的学生辍学率要高得多。

correction.en: The teacher made several corrections to my essay in red ink.
correction.zh: 老师用红笔在我的论文上做了几处修改。

comprehension.en: The reading comprehension test takes about one hour to finish.
comprehension.zh: 阅读理解测试大约需要一小时完成。

quiz.en: We have a short quiz at the start of every Monday class.
quiz.zh: 每周一上课开始时我们都有一个小测验。

quiz.en: The tutor will quiz you on the first three chapters tomorrow.
quiz.zh: 导师明天会就前三章对你们进行测验。

institute.en: She's now working at a research institute in the north of the city.
institute.zh: 她现在在城北的一家研究所工作。

institute.en: The college has instituted a new system for handing in coursework.
institute.zh: 学院设立了一套新的提交作业制度。

dean.en: You'll need a letter from the dean to change your course.
dean.zh: 更换课程需要院长的一封信。

transcript.en: The university asked for an official transcript of my school results.
transcript.zh: 大学要求我提供一份正式的学校成绩单。

transcript.en: You can read a transcript of the radio programme on our website.
transcript.zh: 你可以在我们网站上阅读这期广播节目的文字记录。

fellowship.en: She was awarded a research fellowship at a university in Canada.
fellowship.zh: 她获得了加拿大一所大学的研究员职位。

warden.en: Speak to the warden if you lose the key to your room.
warden.zh: 如果丢了房间钥匙,请联系宿舍管理员。

library-card.en: You'll need your library card to borrow books or use the computers.
library-card.zh: 借书或使用电脑都需要借书卡。

renew.en: You can renew your books online if nobody else has asked for them.
renew.zh: 如果没有其他人预约,你可以在线续借图书。

overdue.en: You'll have to pay a small charge for any overdue books.
overdue.zh: 过期未还的书要交一小笔费用。

fine.en: There's a fine of ten pence a day for books you return late.
fine.zh: 逾期还书每天罚款十便士。

fine.en: The council will fine anyone who leaves rubbish in the street.
fine.zh: 市议会将对在街上乱扔垃圾的人处以罚款。

loan-period.en: The loan period for this book is two weeks, or one if it's in demand.
loan-period.zh: 这本书的借期是两周,如果需求量大则是一周。

reserve.en: You can reserve the book online and collect it at the front desk.
reserve.zh: 你可以在网上预约这本书,然后到前台领取。

reserve.en: We saw several rare birds at the nature reserve near the coast.
reserve.zh: 我们在海岸附近的自然保护区看到了几种珍稀鸟类。

catalogue.en: Search the library catalogue to find out where the book is kept.
catalogue.zh: 查一下图书馆目录,看看这本书放在哪里。

reference-book.en: You can't take this reference book out of the library.
reference-book.zh: 这本参考书不能带出图书馆。

periodical.en: Recent periodicals are on the shelves near the main entrance.
periodical.zh: 最近几期的期刊放在正门附近的书架上。

journal.en: You'll find that article in a psychology journal in the library.
journal.zh: 你可以在图书馆的一本心理学期刊上找到那篇文章。

journal.en: I keep a journal of everything I read for my research.
journal.zh: 我把为研究读过的所有内容都记在日志里。

magazine.en: I read an interesting article about sleep in a science magazine.
magazine.zh: 我在一本科学杂志上读到一篇关于睡眠的有趣文章。

database.en: The library's online database gives you access to thousands of articles.
database.zh: 图书馆的在线数据库能让你查阅数千篇文章。

archive.en: The town's archive holds old photos and letters from the last century.
archive.zh: 小镇的档案馆收藏着上个世纪的老照片和信件。

manuscript.en: The museum has an original manuscript of one of his early novels.
manuscript.zh: 博物馆藏有他早期一部小说的手稿原件。

edition.en: Make sure you buy the latest edition of the textbook.
edition.zh: 一定要买这本教科书的最新版本。

volume.en: The second volume of the encyclopedia is missing from the shelf.
volume.zh: 书架上缺了这部百科全书的第二卷。

volume.en: Please turn down the volume on your computer in the study room.
volume.zh: 在自习室请把电脑音量调低。

author.en: The author of this book will give a talk at the library tomorrow.
author.zh: 这本书的作者明天将在图书馆做讲座。

publisher.en: The publisher has agreed to print a cheaper version for students.
publisher.zh: 出版商同意为学生印刷更便宜的版本。

bibliography.en: Remember to list every book you've used in the bibliography.
bibliography.zh: 记得在参考书目中列出你用过的每一本书。

photocopy.en: You can get a photocopy of the article from the desk upstairs.
photocopy.zh: 你可以到楼上的服务台复印这篇文章。

photocopy.en: Please photocopy this chapter and give it to the rest of the group.
photocopy.zh: 请复印这一章,发给小组其他成员。

printer.en: The printer on the second floor has run out of paper again.
printer.zh: 三楼的打印机又没纸了。

scanner.en: You can use the scanner in the library to copy old documents.
scanner.zh: 你可以用图书馆的扫描仪复制旧文件。

study-room.en: You can book a study room for up to three hours a day.
study-room.zh: 自习室每天最多可预订三小时。

self-service.en: There's a self-service machine where you can return books at any time.
self-service.zh: 有一台自助机,你可以随时还书。

librarian.en: Ask the librarian if you can't find what you're looking for.
librarian.zh: 如果找不到需要的资料,可以问图书管理员。

atlas.en: You'll find an atlas of the world on the shelf by the window.
atlas.zh: 窗边的书架上有一本世界地图集。

encyclopedia.en: An online encyclopedia is a useful place to start your research.
encyclopedia.zh: 网络百科全书是开始研究的好起点。

almanac.en: The farmers' almanac lists the best dates for planting each year.
almanac.zh: 农民年鉴列出了每年最佳的种植日期。

leaflet.en: Take a leaflet from the desk for details of the summer courses.
leaflet.zh: 从服务台取一张传单,了解暑期课程的详情。

memoir.en: Her memoir describes her childhood in a small fishing village.
memoir.zh: 她的回忆录描述了她在一个小渔村的童年。

monograph.en: He spent years writing a monograph on the birds of South America.
monograph.zh: 他花了多年时间撰写一部关于南美鸟类的专著。

chapter.en: For Monday, please read the first chapter of the book.
chapter.zh: 周一之前,请读完这本书的第一章。

index.en: Look in the index at the back to find the page you need.
index.zh: 查看书后的索引,找到你需要的页码。

glossary.en: You'll find a glossary of technical words at the end of the book.
glossary.zh: 书的末尾有一份专业词汇的术语表。

heading.en: Use clear headings to divide your report into separate sections.
heading.zh: 用清晰的标题把报告分成不同的部分。

subheading.en: Each section of the report should have its own subheading.
subheading.zh: 报告的每个部分都应有自己的副标题。

keyword.en: Type a keyword into the search box to find articles on your topic.
keyword.zh: 在搜索框中输入关键词,查找与你的主题相关的文章。

excerpt.en: We'll read an excerpt from the novel and then discuss it in groups.
excerpt.zh: 我们先读这部小说的一段摘录,然后分组讨论。

synopsis.en: Write a short synopsis of the book in about two hundred words.
synopsis.zh: 用大约两百词写一份这本书的简短梗概。

abridge.en: The publisher decided to abridge the novel to make it easier for schools.
abridge.zh: 出版商决定删节这部小说,让它更适合学校使用。

photocopier.en: The photocopier near the entrance only takes coins, not cards.
photocopier.zh: 入口附近的复印机只收硬币,不能刷卡。

skim.en: Try to skim the chapter first, then go back and take notes.
skim.zh: 先试着略读这一章,然后再回头做笔记。

scan.en: Scan the list quickly to see if your name is on it.
scan.zh: 快速扫一眼名单,看看上面有没有你的名字。

scan.en: You can scan the document and send it to me by email.
scan.zh: 你可以把文件扫描后通过邮件发给我。

browse.en: I like to browse the shelves in the library when I have time.
browse.zh: 有时间时,我喜欢在图书馆的书架间浏览。

bookworm.en: My flatmate is a real bookworm and reads at least two novels a week.
bookworm.zh: 我的室友是个十足的书虫,每周至少读两本小说。

non-fiction.en: Most of the non-fiction section is on the third floor of the library.
non-fiction.zh: 非虚构类图书大多在图书馆四楼。

back-issue.en: You can find back issues of the journal in the basement.
back-issue.zh: 你可以在地下室找到这本期刊的过刊。

stack.en: There's a stack of old exam papers on the table by the door.
stack.zh: 门边的桌子上有一堆旧试卷。

stack.en: Older books are kept in the stacks and must be requested at the desk.
stack.zh: 较旧的书放在书库里,要到服务台申请调阅。

footnote.en: Please give the source of each quotation in a footnote.
footnote.zh: 请在脚注中注明每处引文的出处。

booklet.en: The booklet you've been given explains how to use the library.
booklet.zh: 发给你们的小册子说明了如何使用图书馆。

handbook.en: All the rules about late essays are in the student handbook.
handbook.zh: 所有关于迟交论文的规定都在学生手册里。

directory.en: You can find the tutor's phone number in the staff directory.
directory.zh: 你可以在员工名录里找到导师的电话号码。

bulletin.en: The department sends out a weekly bulletin with news about upcoming events.
bulletin.zh: 院系每周发一份简报,介绍即将举行的活动。

folder.en: Save all your project files in one folder on the shared drive.
folder.zh: 把所有项目文件保存在共享盘的一个文件夹里。

research.en: Her research looks at how children learn a second language.
research.zh: 她的研究关注儿童如何学习第二语言。

research.en: I need to research the topic properly before I start writing.
research.zh: 动笔之前,我需要好好研究这个课题。

project.en: Our group project is about recycling in the local community.
project.zh: 我们的小组项目是关于当地社区的垃圾回收。

proposal.en: You must hand in your research proposal to your tutor by March.
proposal.zh: 你必须在三月前把研究开题报告交给导师。

objective.en: The main objective of the study is to measure noise levels near schools.
objective.zh: 这项研究的主要目标是测量学校附近的噪音水平。

objective.en: It's hard to stay objective when you're writing about your own family.
objective.zh: 写自己的家人时,很难保持客观。

methodology.en: In this section, you should explain the methodology of your study.
methodology.zh: 在这一部分,你应该说明你研究的方法论。

questionnaire.en: We gave out a questionnaire to two hundred students in the canteen.
questionnaire.zh: 我们在食堂向两百名学生发放了问卷。

survey.en: The survey found that most students walk or cycle to college.
survey.zh: 调查发现,大多数学生步行或骑车上学。

survey.en: We plan to survey local shoppers about their use of plastic bags.
survey.zh: 我们计划调查当地购物者使用塑料袋的情况。

interviewee.en: Each interviewee was asked the same ten questions about their diet.
interviewee.zh: 每位受访者都被问了同样十个关于饮食的问题。

respondent.en: More than half the respondents said they used public transport every day.
respondent.zh: 超过一半的调查对象表示他们每天乘坐公共交通。

sample.en: We used a sample of one hundred people from different age groups.
sample.zh: 我们使用了一个来自不同年龄段的一百人样本。

data.en: We'll collect the data first and then look for any patterns.
data.zh: 我们先收集数据,再寻找其中的规律。

statistics.en: Official statistics show that fewer people are buying newspapers.
statistics.zh: 官方统计数据显示,买报纸的人越来越少。

statistics.en: Statistics is the hardest part of my psychology course this year.
statistics.zh: 统计学是我今年心理学课程中最难的部分。

analysis.en: Our analysis of the results will take at least another two weeks.
analysis.zh: 我们对结果的分析至少还需要两周。

findings.en: The findings of the study will be published in a journal next year.
findings.zh: 这项研究的发现将于明年发表在期刊上。

conclusion.en: You should restate your main idea in the conclusion of your essay.
conclusion.zh: 你应该在论文结论中重申你的主要观点。

appendix.en: Put a copy of your questionnaire in the appendix at the end.
appendix.zh: 把问卷放在文末的附录中。

literature-review.en: I've almost finished the literature review, but I still need to read two articles.
literature-review.zh: 我的文献综述快写完了,但还要读两篇文章。

case-study.en: We looked at one small company as a case study for the course.
case-study.zh: 我们把一家小公司作为这门课的个案研究对象。

field-trip.en: We're going on a field trip to the coast to study rock pools.
field-trip.zh: 我们要去海边实地考察,研究岩石潮池。

experiment.en: We need to repeat the experiment because the first results were unclear.
experiment.zh: 我们需要重做实验,因为第一次的结果不明确。

observation.en: Our conclusions are based on careful observation of the children at play.
observation.zh: 我们的结论基于对孩子们玩耍时的仔细观察。

trial.en: The trial of the new teaching method will run for six months.
trial.zh: 新教学方法的试验将持续六个月。

trial.en: The trial lasted two weeks, and the man was found not guilty.
trial.zh: 审判持续了两周,该男子被判无罪。

outline.en: Please show me an outline of your essay before you start writing.
outline.zh: 开始写之前,请给我看一下你的论文大纲。

summary.en: Write a brief summary of the article in your own words.
summary.zh: 用你自己的话写一篇这篇文章的简短摘要。

abstract.en: Read the abstract first to see if the article is useful to you.
abstract.zh: 先读摘要,看看这篇文章对你是否有用。

abstract.en: Young children often find it hard to understand abstract ideas like time.
abstract.zh: 幼儿往往很难理解时间这样的抽象概念。

chart.en: The chart on page ten shows how spending has changed since 2000.
chart.zh: 第十页的图表显示了 2000 年以来支出的变化。

diagram.en: Label each part of the machine on the diagram in your notes.
diagram.zh: 在笔记的示意图上标出机器的各个部分。

graph.en: The graph shows that sales rise sharply just before the holidays.
graph.zh: 曲线图显示,销量在假期前急剧上升。

table.en: The table below compares the cost of living in three cities.
table.zh: 下表比较了三个城市的生活成本。

visual-aid.en: Using a visual aid can make your talk much easier to follow.
visual-aid.zh: 使用视觉辅助工具能让你的发言更容易理解。

teamwork.en: Good teamwork is essential if you want to finish the project on time.
teamwork.zh: 想按时完成项目,良好的团队合作必不可少。

division-of-labour.en: A clear division of labour meant that each of us knew what to do.
division-of-labour.zh: 明确的分工让我们每个人都清楚自己该做什么。

concise.en: Keep your answers clear and concise, as you only have ten minutes.
concise.zh: 回答要清楚简洁,因为你只有十分钟。

wordy.en: Your essay is rather wordy, so try to cut out some sentences.
wordy.zh: 你的论文有些啰嗦,试着删掉一些句子。

redundant.en: This word is redundant here, because you've already said the same thing.
redundant.zh: 这个词在这里是多余的,因为你已经说过同样的意思了。

redundant.en: Forty workers were made redundant when the factory closed last year.
redundant.zh: 去年工厂关闭时,四十名工人被裁员。

clarity.en: Your tutor will give you marks for clarity as well as for your ideas.
clarity.zh: 导师既看你的观点,也会就表达是否清晰给分。

brief.en: I'd like to make a few brief comments before we start the discussion.
brief.zh: 开始讨论之前,我想简短说几句。

brief.en: Our manager gave us a brief on the new project this morning.
brief.zh: 今天上午经理就新项目给我们做了简报。

paraphrase.en: Try to paraphrase the author's ideas instead of copying the exact words.
paraphrase.zh: 尽量改述作者的观点,不要照抄原文。

interrupt.en: Sorry to interrupt, but could you repeat the last point, please?
interrupt.zh: 抱歉打断一下,您能再说一遍最后一点吗?

skip.en: You can skip the second chapter, as it won't be in the exam.
skip.zh: 第二章你可以跳过,因为考试不考。

overview.en: The first lecture will give you an overview of the whole course.
overview.zh: 第一次讲座将为你概述整门课程。

rewrite.en: I had to rewrite the introduction because my tutor found it unclear.
rewrite.zh: 导师觉得引言不清楚,所以我只好重写。

panel.en: A panel of three experts will judge the students' projects.
panel.zh: 由三位专家组成的专家组将评审学生的项目。

format.en: Your report must follow the format given in the course handbook.
format.zh: 你的报告必须遵循课程手册中规定的格式。

enquiry.en: Please direct any enquiry about fees to the main office.
enquiry.zh: 有关费用的任何询问,请直接联系总办公室。

enquire.en: I'm calling to enquire about the French classes you offer.
enquire.zh: 我打电话是想询问你们开设的法语课。

display.en: Students' paintings are on display in the hall this week.
display.zh: 本周学生们的画作在大厅展出。

display.en: The screen will display your exam results when you enter your number.
display.zh: 输入学号后,屏幕会显示你的考试成绩。

recommendation.en: The report ends with a recommendation to build more cycle paths.
recommendation.zh: 报告最后建议修建更多自行车道。

announcement.en: There will be an announcement about the exam dates next week.
announcement.zh: 下周会发布关于考试日期的公告。

profile.en: Update your online profile so that employers can see your experience.
profile.zh: 更新你的网上简介,让雇主能看到你的经历。

batch.en: We'll send out the next batch of letters to students on Friday.
batch.zh: 我们将在周五给学生寄出下一批信件。

postpone.en: We've had to postpone the meeting until next Thursday.
postpone.zh: 我们不得不把会议推迟到下周四。
